outlook.statement: Digital media segment projected to grow at 14% CAGR from CY 2025 to CY 2028E, reaching approximately INR 1.64 trillion, supported by continued expansion in digital advertising, increasing subscription adoption, deeper regional language penetration, and ongoing digital transformation of consumer and advertiser behaviour
Digital advertising market projected to grow at 14% CAGR to reach approximately INR 1,393 billion by CY 2028E
Digital subscription revenues projected to reach INR 248 billion by CY 2028, supported by continued growth across video, audio, and premium content offerings
Real GDP growth for FY 2026-27E projected in range of 6.6%, with headline inflation estimated at 5.1% and core inflation at 4.7%
hindustantimes.com remains focused on expanding its digital footprint through high-quality journalism, technology-led innovation and deeper audience engagement
Company remains focused on building a resilient and sustainable digital media business anchored in a scaled direct audience ecosystem, with app-led growth as key strategic priority
Will pursue balanced growth strategy by further diversifying and strengthening revenue streams across advertising, subscriptions, and transactional businesses
Expects to continually refine strategy, innovate across products and offerings, and leverage technology to enhance audience engagement and create long-term value
livehindustan.com focused on strengthening leadership in Hindi digital news market through high-quality journalism, hyperlocal relevance and continuous product innovation
livemint.com remains focused on strengthening premium editorial proposition and deepening relationships with subscriber base
